lines.zh: 幽幽光闪，宛如夜之幽灵。
lines.en: Glimmering light, like a night spirit.

lines.zh: 血光乍现，追逐鬼杀队的影子。
lines.en: Bloodlight flickers, chasing the Hunter's shadow.

lines.zh: 玉壶之魂，飘忽于月光下。
lines.en: Yuhu's soul, drifting under moonlight.
In moonlight, a pale shadow.
In cold light, moves forward grimly.
Uncertain, like a ghost.
Flee into darkness, away from sunlight.
Glimmering under moonlight.
Moves slowly under moonlight.
Drifting in moonlight.
Water whispers in my pot with each step.

lines.zh: 我从阴影滑向另一片阴影。
lines.en: I glide from one shadow to the next.
Stands quietly, waiting for prey.
Silent like a ghost, quietly waiting.
Yuhu's soul, silent.
Exists quietly in darkness.
Hides quietly in darkness.

lines.zh: 等待猎物靠近，悄然无声。
lines.en: Quietly waits for prey to approach.
Quietly watches the prey.
Silent in the night.

lines.zh: 静静地等待着，悄然无声。
lines.en: Quietly waiting, without a sound.

lines.zh: 静静的，等待着命运的降临。
lines.en: Quietly, waiting for fate to unfold.
Detects prey, eyes like torches.
Fixes gaze, vicious light appears.

lines.zh: 紧盯着猎物，不放过一丝机会。
lines.en: Stares at the prey, leaving no chance.
Eyes like lightning, locking the target.

lines.zh: 注视着猎物，眼中满是仇恨。
lines.en: Fills eyes with hate, staring at the prey.
Gleaming with cruelty in the eyes.
Eyes like an eagle, locking the target.
Eyes like a wolf, staring at the prey.
Eyes like blades, sharp and deadly.

lines.zh: 壶中映出的你，我盯了半天。
lines.en: I've stared a long while at you in my vase's reflection.
Cracks appear, unbearable pain!
Skin tears, blood gushes out!
Sunlight burns, excruciating pain!

lines.zh: 鬼杀队员的剑伤，伤势严重！
lines.en: Swordsman's blade, severe injury!
Weakness, on the brink of death!
Internal cracks, hanging by a thread!
Unable to fight back, excruciating pain!

lines.zh: 伤口不断渗血，痛入骨髓！
lines.en: Continuous bleeding, pain to the bone!

lines.zh: 鬼杀队的刀刃，伤口深重！
lines.en: Blade wounds, deep and painful!
Severely beaten, scars everywhere!
The blood on you is sweet, Yuhu!

lines.zh: 鬼杀队的武士们，尝尝我的利爪！
lines.en: Taste my claws, swordsmen of the Demon Slayer Corps!
Don't go, become an evil ghost with me!

lines.zh: 看你身上的伤痕，我来帮你舔舐！
lines.en: I'll help you with your wounds.

lines.zh: 你体内有我需要的力量！
lines.en: Power flows within you.
Join me, share this darkness.
I will become an evil ghost to be with you.
Your blood, I want it!

lines.zh: 鬼杀队的战士，享受我的拥抱！
lines.en: Demon Slayer Corps, feel my embrace!

lines.zh: 你身上的血，能让我更强！
lines.en: Your blood will make me stronger.
Move, or I'll kill you!

lines.zh: 我的利爪会撕裂你的皮肉！
lines.en: My claws will tear through your flesh!

lines.zh: 鬼杀队的战士，你逃不掉！
lines.en: Swordsman, you cannot escape!
Stay back, or you'll die!
Avoid the sunlight, I hate light!

lines.zh: 你离我太近了，我会杀了你！
lines.en: You're too close, I'll kill you!
Move, or I'll bite you!

lines.zh: 鬼杀队的战士，你离我太近！
lines.en: Swordsman, you're too close!
Don't touch me, or you'll regret it!

lines.zh: 靠近我，你会受到我的惩罚！
lines.en: Come near me, and you'll be punished.

lines.zh: 和我交配，你会变得更强！
lines.en: Mate with me, and you'll be stronger!

lines.zh: 你和我交配，会成为恶鬼！
lines.en: Mate with me, and you'll become an evil ghost.

lines.zh: 加入我，成为恶鬼的一员！
lines.en: Join me, become one of the evil ghosts!
Mate with me, and you'll be stronger!
Out of the chrysalis, I still want a mate.
Mate, the power of the evil ghosts!

lines.zh: 和我交配，你将获得力量！
lines.en: Mate with me, you'll gain power!
Mate with me, become an evil ghost!

lines.zh: 蜕了壳，我更想有个人陪着。
lines.en: Shedding my shell makes me want someone beside me.
Mate, and you'll gain power!
Shell breaks, foul wind rises.
Yuhu awakens, evil aura spreads.
Blood essence nurtures demon soul.
Demonization of Yuhu, watch out, Demon Slayer Squad.
Evade sunlight, demon appears.
Feed on souls, nourish my body.
Reside in darkness, wait for prey.
Evil Yuhu, start of demonization.
Aso's blood, aid my transformation.
Blood Demon Arts, strengthen demonic power.
Prey near, hunt begins.
Demon Slayer Squad, here I come.
Blood contract, you can't escape.

lines.zh: 吞噬灵魂，永世不得超生。
lines.en: Consume souls, eternal suffering.
Demon Slayer Squad, beware my attacks.
In the darkness, my sight.
Your life will belong to me.
Prey, hunt.

lines.zh: 无惨之血，助我一臂之力。
lines.en: Aso's blood, gives me strength.
Yuhu demonizes, prey revealed.
That Demon Slayer uniform stings my eyes.
Upper Rank Five. Remember that.
The smell of a nichirin blade arrives.
I am not picky about your blood type.
Shedding my shell leaves me hungry.
Chase prey, fear no sunlight.
Under sunlight, demon power weakens.
Close combat, swift, fatal strike.
I hide under the sunlight.
Yuhu, second form.
Demonization is hidden under sunlight.
Demon Slayer Squad, I won't let you go.
Consume souls, damn to hell.
Aso's blood, strengthens demon abilities.
Under sunlight, I am stronger.
I count the gaps between your swings.

lines.zh: 你的刀再快也砍不到水。
lines.en: Your blade is fast, but it cannot cut water.
My Blood Demon Art flows between my fingers.

lines.zh: 别抬头，我的壶在你上方。
lines.en: Do not look up; my pot is above you.

lines.zh: 阳光照进来的话我就走。
lines.en: If sunlight reaches me, I leave.

lines.zh: 蛹壳蜕了，第二形态更狠。
lines.en: The chrysalis is shed; my second form bites harder.

lines.zh: 近距离才能撕开你的喉咙。
lines.en: Only up close can I tear your throat.
This patch of darkness suits me.
I wait for you to raise your blade overhead.

lines.zh: 无惨的血在我体内翻涌。
lines.en: Muzan's blood churns inside me.
Transform into a blade piercing the foe's chest
Swing the blade to cut through the dark spirits
Summon the Blood Trick: Yuhu
Sunlight does not harm me
Tear apart the foe's flesh with bare hands
The blade glimmers like ghostly flames
The blood of Oni no Sadamasa nourishes my strength
More vicious under the blood moon
Dance around the foe in a ghostly manner
The blade slices through the space gap
A water prison wraps your limbs!
My fingertips pierce your shoulder!
My pot opens and spits a water blade!
I trap you with my shed shell!
This claw rips your uniform open!
Flesh churns inside my pot!
Your blade strikes my pot's wall!
My second form holds far more than this!
Yuhu emerges from its cocoon
Appears silently in the underworld
Emerges with the tide of evil spirits
Awakens quietly under the night sky
Wanders in the realm of the impermanent
Roams unpredictably in the Ghost Slayer's domain
The soul of an evil spirit takes form
Born in the shadows
Given life by the blood of Oni no Sadamasa
Lurks quietly in the darkness
The cocoon splits and I step out.
My pot is filled with moonlight.
I shed my shell and took a new shape.
A vessel rising from the water's floor.
Burned by flames, unbearable!
Fell into the valley, severe injuries!
Drowned, excruciating pain!

lines.zh: 爆风撕开我的鳞片，我低吼。
lines.en: The blast tears my scales; I growl low.
Arrow wounds, severe injuries!
Magic blast, skin tearing!
Starving, weak and defenseless!
Lightning strike, unbearable pain!
Void fear, hanging by a thread!
